title: myosotis laxa f. neglecta
intro: Myosotis laxa f. neglecta, commonly known as Alpine Forget-me-not, is a flowering plant species within the borage family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Forget-me-not include acting as a demulcent to protect and soothe mucous membranes, as well as having antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects.
